info.name: YouTube iOS 27 Liquid Glass
info.description:
Experience YouTube with an ultra-sleek iOS 27 Liquid Glassmorphism design! Featuring Apple SF typography, rounded pill search bar, smooth spring physics animations, and floating widget-style video cards.

✨ Key Features:
• Vision Glassmorphic UI with deep blur and glowing accents
• Pill-shaped search bar with focus glow
• Floating dock header & side navigation
• iOS widget-style video tiles for high readability
• Custom smooth floating scrollbar

⚠️ Note: Please make sure YouTube Dark Mode is turned ON for the best visual experience.
